en: Does your child respond when they hear their name?
zh: 你嘅小朋友喺聽到佢個名嘅時候會唔會回應你？

en: Does your kid make eye contact with you?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會主動同你做眼神接觸？

en: Does your kid avoid making eye contact with you?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會迴避你嘅眼神接觸？

en: Does your child bring things they like to show you?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會拎住佢鍾意嘅嘢嚟俾你睇？

en: When you point at something, does your child look in the direction you’re pointing?
zh: 你指住一樣嘢嘅時候，你嘅小朋友會唔會望向你指嘅方向？

en: Does your child look at you, then at what you’re looking at?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會望住你，再望返你望緊嘅嘢？

en: Does your child copy your actions, such as clapping or waving?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會學你嘅動作，例如拍手或者揮手？

en: Does your child copy your facial expressions or sounds?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會學你嘅表情或者聲音？

en: When your child sees other children, do they show interest by watching or moving closer?
zh: 你嘅小朋友見到其他小朋友，會唔會有興趣望吓或者行埋去？

en: Does your child want to play together with other children?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會想同其他小朋友一齊玩？

en: Does your child make babbling sounds like “mama” or “baba”?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會發出「媽媽」「爸爸」呢類牙牙學語嘅聲音？

en: Does your child say single words, like “rice” or “mama”?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會講到單字/疊字，例如「飯飯」或者「媽媽」？

en: Does your child put two words together, like “want drink” or “mama hold”?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會將兩個字連埋一齊講，例如「要飲」「媽媽抱」？

en: Does your child use words to say what they want, not only repeat what they hear?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會用說話表達自己想要嘅嘢，而唔係淨係重複聽到嘅說話？

en: Does your child repeat what you said instead of answering you?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會重複你講過嘅說話，而唔係回答你？

en: Does your child wave hello or goodbye?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會揮手同人打招呼或者表示再見？

en: Does your child use gestures to show what they want, like reaching to be picked up or shaking their head for “no”?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會用手勢表達想要嘅嘢，例如伸手要抱、搖頭表示唔要？

en: Does your child line up toys, or watch spinning things for a long time?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會將玩具排成一行，或者好長時間望住會轉嘅嘢？

en: Does your child repeat the same movement, such as hand-flapping, rocking or walking in circles?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會重複做同一個動作，例如拍手、搖晃身體或者行圈？

en: When routines change (like taking a different route), does your child get very upset or find it hard to calm down?
zh: 日常安排有改變（例如轉行另一條路）嘅時候，你嘅小朋友會唔會好抗拒或者好難安撫？

en: Is your child very fixated on one or two things, and hard to redirect?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會對某一兩樣嘢特別著迷，而且好難轉移佢嘅注意力？

en: When your child hears loud or sudden sounds (like a vacuum or hair dryer), do they react strongly, such as covering their ears or crying?
zh: 聽到大聲或者突然嘅聲音（例如吸塵機、吹風機），你嘅小朋友會唔會有好大反應，例如掩耳或者喊？

en: Does your child avoid or get upset by bright or flashing lights?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會好抗拒猛烈或者閃爍嘅光線？

en: Does your child strongly dislike certain textures, such as clothing tags, sand or sticky things?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會好抗拒某啲唔同嘅質感，例如衫嘅標籤、沙或者黐黐哋嘅嘢？

en: Does your child refuse food because of its texture or smell?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會因為食物嘅質感或者氣味而唔肯進食？

en: Does your child keep seeking certain sensations, such as constant jumping, crashing into things, or sniffing and licking objects?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會不斷尋找新奇嘅感覺，例如不停跳、撞嚟撞去，或者聞同舔啲物件？

en: When your child gets hurt, do they seem to show little reaction?
zh: 你嘅小朋友跌親或者撞親嘅時候，會唔會好似冇乜反應？

en: Does your child do pretend play, like cooking or feeding a doll?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會鍾意玩煮飯仔，例如扮煮飯或者餵公仔食嘢？

en: Does your child play with several kinds of toys, or only one or two?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會玩幾種唔同嘅玩具，定係淨係玩一兩樣？

en: Does your child use toys the usual way, like pushing a toy car, rather than only spinning its wheels?
zh: 你嘅小朋友會唔會用玩具原本嘅玩法，例如推玩具車，而唔係淨係轉車輪？

en: Has your child ever lost words or social skills they used to have?
zh: 你嘅小朋友有冇試過原本識講嘅說話，或者原本識做嘅社交行為，後來變得唔識或者減少咗？

en: Have you noticed your child having a seizure, or something you think could be a seizure?
zh: 你有冇留意到小朋友曾經出現抽搐，或者懷疑有抽搐？

en: Have you noticed your child hurting themselves?
zh: 你有冇留意到小朋友有傷害自己嘅行為？
